lines.t: Mountains bow to His name they fall
Oceans hush when He calls it all
The stars align in His perfect will
Every moment calm or still
There is none like YahuShua no not one
A perfect reflection of the Holy One
He shines so bright brighter than the sun
There is none like YahuShua no not one
He speaks life where shadows lay
Turns the night into brightest day
Chains are broken hearts are healed
His love is all the world revealed
Oh tell me where else could we run
When His mercy has already won
There is none like YahuShua no not one
A perfect reflection of the Holy One
He shines so bright brighter than the sun
There is none like YahuShua no not one
Lift your hands feel the heavens near
Every cry every doubt disappears
Oh His name is the sweetest sound
Breaking walls it shakes the grounds
